source: Opinion: The county should sign the desalination contract this month. Reservoirs have missed spring targets twice, and a guaranteed coastal supply would give planners a backstop before the next dry cycle. Councilmember Reed told the Sentinel, "A desalination contract will saddle ratepayers with high bills before we know whether conservation targets work." That objection treats delay as free. The author disagrees: waiting another two summers risks buying emergency water at a worse price.
